arabic text: HAI BABA YAHAAN PAR BARAA SA ANDHERA, SAKINA KO\nKYUN CHHOR KAR JAA RAHE HAI
english translation text: Father, it is so dark here.\nWhy are you leaving Sakina behind?

arabic text: KAHAA ROKE BAQIR NE AABID SE BABA,\nSAKINA KO KYUN CHHOR KAR JAA RAHE HAI,
english translation text: Baqir stopped Abid and said, ‘Father,\nwhy are you leaving Sakina behind?’

arabic text:
HAAN DEKHA HAI MAINE SAFAR MAI YEH MANZAR,
JAHAAN PAANI HOTA THA ISS KO MAYASSAR,
TOH KHUD APNE HISSE KA PAANI HAMESHA,
GIRAATI THI YEH AAP KI BERIYON PAR,
MAYASSAR HAI AB HAMKO PAANI TOH PYAASA,
SAKINA KO KYUN CHHOR KAR JAA RAHE HAI
english translation text:
I witnessed this throughout the journey:
whenever water became available to her,
she would pour her own share
upon your shackles. Now that water
is available to us, why are
you leaving thirsty Sakina behind?

arabic text:
JHUKAAYE HUWE APNA SAR RORAHI HAI,
RIHAAI KI SUNKAR KHABAR RORAHI HAI
TARAPTI HAI DAADI RUBAB AISE BABA,
KE AMMA BHI THAAME JIGAR RORAHI HAI,
BATAAYENGE KYA GHAR UNHONE YE PUCHHA,
SAKINA KO KYUN CHHOR KAR JAA RAHE HAI
english translation text:
She sits with her head bowed, weeping even
after hearing the news of freedom. Grandmother
Rubab is in such anguish that even
my mother weeps, clutching her heart. ‘What
will we tell those at home?’ she
asks. Why are you leaving Sakina behind?

arabic text:
MUJHE YAAD HAI KHUD YEH KEHTE THE DAADA,
MADINA HAI ISS KE SABAB SE MADINA,
KE MERI NAZAR MAI WOH GHAR GHAR NAHI HAI,
NAZAR JIS MAI AAYE NA MUJHKO SAKINA,
NA ISS KE SIWA PHIR BASEGA MADINA,
SAKINA KO KYUN CHHOR KAR JAA RAHE HAI
english translation text:
I remember Grandfather himself saying, ‘Madina is
Madina because of her. In my eyes,
no house is truly a home if
Sakina is not seen within it. Madina
will not flourish again without her.’
Why are you leaving Sakina behind?

arabic text:
MADINA HO YA SHAAM KARBOBALA HO,
KE BAZAARO DARBAAR KA MARHALAA
SADAA HAT SITAM HAMNE JHELAA HAI MILKAR,
TOH PHIR KYUN NA YEH MERE DIL KI SADAA HO,
MUJHE BHI YAHIN CHHORNA AY BABA,
SAKINA KO KYUN CHHOR KAR JAA RAHE HAI
english translation text:
Whether in Madina, Shaam or Karbala, through
every marketplace and court, we endured
each cruelty together. Then why should
this not be the cry of
my heart: leave me here too,
Father—why are you leaving Sakina behind?

arabic text:
MUJHE AAJ YAAD AARAHA HAI WOH LAMHA,
GIRI THI JO NAAQE SE IK DIN SAKINA,
LAGE AAP KI PUSHT PAR TAAZIYAANE,
MAGAR AAPNE QAAFILA ROK-KE RAKHAA,
RUKAALE YUHIN QAAFILA AAJ BABA,
SAKINA KO KYUN CHHOR KAR JAA RAHE HAI
english translation text:
Today I remember the moment when
Sakina fell from the camel. Lashes
struck your back, yet you stopped
the caravan for her. Stop the
caravan once again today, Father—why
are you leaving Sakina behind?

arabic text:
ACHAANAK NIGAAHE PARI JO LAHAD PAR,
SAWAALAAT PHIR LAB PE AAYE NA AKBAR,
SAKINA KI TURBAT KO SINE LAGAAYE,
PADAR SE YEH KEHNE LAGE ROKE BAQIR,
SAMAJH MAI MERI AB HAI BABA YEH AAYA,
SAKINA KO KYUN CHHOR KAR JAA RAHE HAI
english translation text:
When his eyes suddenly fell upon
the grave, Akbar’s questions no longer
reached his lips. Embracing Sakina’s tomb,
Baqir wept and said to his
father, ‘Now I understand, Father, why
you are leaving Sakina behind.’

arabic text: SAKINA KO KYUN CHHOR KAR JAA RAHE HAI
english translation text: Why are you leaving Sakina behind?
